description: Plain-language labels for the model features, shown next to explanations. They describe what a statistic measures; they do not say whether a value is good or bad.

Flow Duration.label: How long the connection lasted
Flow Duration.meaning: From the first to the last packet of the flow.

Total Fwd Packets.label: Packets sent by the initiator
Total Fwd Packets.meaning: Packets going from the connection's initiator to the other side.

Total Backward Packets.label: Packets sent in reply
Total Backward Packets.meaning: Packets coming back from the responder.

Total Length of Fwd Packets.label: Data sent by the initiator
Total Length of Fwd Packets.meaning: Total payload bytes sent by the initiator.

Total Length of Bwd Packets.label: Data sent in reply
Total Length of Bwd Packets.meaning: Total payload bytes sent back by the responder.

Fwd Packet Length Max.label: Largest packet sent
Fwd Packet Length Max.meaning: Size of the biggest packet from the initiator.

Fwd Packet Length Min.label: Smallest packet sent
Fwd Packet Length Min.meaning: Size of the smallest packet from the initiator.

Fwd Packet Length Mean.label: Typical packet size sent
Fwd Packet Length Mean.meaning: Average size of the initiator's packets.

Fwd Packet Length Std.label: Variation in sent packet size
Fwd Packet Length Std.meaning: How much the initiator's packet sizes vary; 0 means all equal.

Bwd Packet Length Max.label: Largest reply packet
Bwd Packet Length Max.meaning: Size of the biggest packet from the responder.

Bwd Packet Length Min.label: Smallest reply packet
Bwd Packet Length Min.meaning: Size of the smallest packet from the responder.

Bwd Packet Length Mean.label: Typical reply packet size
Bwd Packet Length Mean.meaning: Average size of the responder's packets.

Bwd Packet Length Std.label: Variation in reply packet size
Bwd Packet Length Std.meaning: How much the responder's packet sizes vary; 0 means all equal.

Flow Bytes/s.label: Data rate
Flow Bytes/s.meaning: Bytes per second over the whole flow; very high values suggest floods or bulk transfers.

Flow Packets/s.label: Packets per second
Flow Packets/s.meaning: Packet rate over the whole flow; very high values suggest floods or scans.

Flow IAT Mean.label: Average gap between packets
Flow IAT Mean.meaning: Mean time between two consecutive packets in either direction.

Flow IAT Std.label: Irregularity of packet gaps
Flow IAT Std.meaning: How much the gap between packets varies; low values mean machine-like regularity.

Flow IAT Min.label: Shortest gap between packets
Flow IAT Min.meaning: Smallest time between two consecutive packets.

Fwd IAT Total.label: Time spent sending
Fwd IAT Total.meaning: Sum of the gaps between the initiator's packets.

Fwd IAT Mean.label: Average gap between sent packets
Fwd IAT Mean.meaning: Mean time between two packets from the initiator.

Bwd IAT Total.label: Time spent replying
Bwd IAT Total.meaning: Sum of the gaps between the responder's packets.

Bwd IAT Mean.label: Average gap between reply packets
Bwd IAT Mean.meaning: Mean time between two packets from the responder.

Fwd PSH Flags.label: Push flags sent
Fwd PSH Flags.meaning: Times the initiator set the TCP push flag (deliver data now).

Fwd Packets/s.label: Sending packet rate
Fwd Packets/s.meaning: Packets per second sent by the initiator.

Bwd Packets/s.label: Reply packet rate
Bwd Packets/s.meaning: Packets per second sent back by the responder.

Min Packet Length.label: Smallest packet in the flow
Min Packet Length.meaning: Size of the smallest packet in either direction.

Max Packet Length.label: Largest packet in the flow
Max Packet Length.meaning: Size of the biggest packet in either direction.

Packet Length Mean.label: Typical packet size
Packet Length Mean.meaning: Average packet size over the whole flow.

Packet Length Std.label: Variation in packet size
Packet Length Std.meaning: How much packet sizes vary over the whole flow.

FIN Flag Count.label: Connection-close flags (FIN)
FIN Flag Count.meaning: Packets that politely close a TCP connection.

SYN Flag Count.label: Connection-open flags (SYN)
SYN Flag Count.meaning: Packets that start a TCP connection; many SYNs and few replies is typical of scans and SYN floods.

RST Flag Count.label: Connection-reset flags (RST)
RST Flag Count.meaning: Packets that abruptly refuse or abort a TCP connection.

PSH Flag Count.label: Push flags (PSH)
PSH Flag Count.meaning: Packets asking the receiver to deliver data immediately.

URG Flag Count.label: Urgent flags (URG)
URG Flag Count.meaning: Packets marked as urgent; rare in normal traffic.

Down/Up Ratio.label: Download to upload ratio
Down/Up Ratio.meaning: Data coming back divided by data sent.

Init_Win_bytes_forward.label: Initial receive window (initiator)
Init_Win_bytes_forward.meaning: TCP window the initiator advertised at the start; depends on the operating system and tool.

Init_Win_bytes_backward.label: Initial receive window (responder)
Init_Win_bytes_backward.meaning: TCP window the responder advertised at the start.

act_data_pkt_fwd.label: Packets that carried data (sent)
act_data_pkt_fwd.meaning: Initiator packets with at least one byte of payload.

min_seg_size_forward.label: Smallest segment header size (sent)
min_seg_size_forward.meaning: Minimum TCP header size seen from the initiator.

Active Mean.label: Average active period
Active Mean.meaning: Mean time the flow was busy before going idle.

Idle Mean.label: Average idle period
Idle Mean.meaning: Mean time the flow stayed silent between active periods.
